_comment: Explicit non-derived credentials only. Every app in apps.json with a 'readback' block already gets a self-scoped credential whose key derives from its id (see ClientKeyMap / MONOLITH_KEY_SEED). Add an entry here only for the owner key or a genuine cross-app consumer. readScope: 'all' | 'none' | an app id. reports: reports.json ids ('["*"]' = all).
